title: v1_140 / Release highlights
content: ## Release highlights This release expands agent workflows, improves worktree reuse, and adds enterprise AI controls. * [Copilot harness](#copilot-harness): Use the Copilot harness and get consistent agent behavior across Copilot products. * [Multi-folder sessions (Experimental)](#multi-folder-sessions-experimental): Work on tasks across multiple folders within a single agent session. * [Remote delegation (Experimental)](#delegate-tasks-to-remote-agent-hosts-experimental): Delegate tasks to connected remote agent hosts. * [HydraFusion (Research Preview)](#hydrafusion-model-orchestration-research-preview): Let multiple models draft, critique, and revise coding tasks without coordinating them yourself. * [Shared worktree folders (Experimental)](#reuse-ignored-folders-across-worktrees-experimental): Avoid repeated dependency installs and duplicated artifacts by reusing ignored folders across worktrees. * [Enterprise controls](#enterprise): Ensure everyone in your org follows AI version requirements and defaults.
